assumptions: The alignment is the family's; DegePrime's window and degeneracy rules apply.
limits: DegePrime's own oligo comes from a randomised unseeded search that no port can reproduce, so it is used as a bar our search must clear at every window, with an exact branch-and-bound as the third check.
Coverage is over the alignment given, not over the family in nature.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which degenerate primers amplify every member of this aligned family, and how much of it does each cover?

description: Design degenerate primers from a multiple-sequence ALIGNMENT - the 'amplify every homologue in this family' question, which a single-template designer cannot answer because it only ever sees one sequence. A faithful port of DegePrime (Hugerth et al. 2014). Wire an upstream align_sequences `rows` output straight in, or paste an aligned FASTA.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

algorithm.description: which search picks each window's oligo. `wrm` is DegePrime's own default and is randomised (hence `seed`); `exhaustive` is an exact branch-and-bound that GRADES the heuristics rather than letting them grade each other, and REFUSES a window too large to solve rather than guessing - the problem is NP-hard.

alignment.description: the ALIGNED rows to scan, each `{ name, sequence }` with gaps preserved - wire an upstream `align_sequences` rows output here. Gaps carry information the scan reads, so an unaligned set is not a substitute.

alignment_fasta.description: an aligned FASTA to scan, when there is no upstream alignment to wire. Sequences must already BE aligned - equal length, gaps as `-`.

exhaustive_mer_limit.description: largest number of distinct mers `exhaustive` will attempt before refusing a window. Only applies when algorithm is exhaustive. Advanced.

iterations.description: WRM restarts (`-iter`). Only applies when algorithm is wrm. Advanced.

limit.description: how many pairs to return, best coverage first. Advanced.

max_degeneracy.description: degeneracy ceiling (`-d`) - how many distinct oligos the IUPAC code is allowed to stand for. Coerced DOWN when no combination of positions can multiply to it, and the run says so.

max_product.description: longest product, in TRIMMED alignment columns. In col.

min_depth.description: fewest gapless sequences a window needs before it is reported at all (`-depth`). Advanced.

min_fraction_matching.description: a window must bind at least this fraction of the spanning sequences to be a candidate - the coverage floor, and the number that decides whether 'every homologue' is true.

min_product.description: shortest product, in TRIMMED alignment columns. In col.

seed.description: seed for WRM's draw, so a run is REPRODUCIBLE. Upstream is unseeded, so the same alignment can give two answers; a design you cannot reproduce is not one you can order from. Only applies when algorithm is wrm. Advanced.

skip.description: bases excluded at each end of every sequence (`-skip`). In nt. Advanced.

trim_cutoff.description: columns occupied by less than this fraction of sequences are dropped before scanning. Trimming renumbers the alignment, which is why `keptColumns` comes back with the result. Advanced.

name: design_degenerate_primers

degeneracyCoerced.description: true when the ceiling was lowered, so a run never silently answers a different question than it was asked

forward.description: the best pair's forward oligo, IUPAC. Empty when no pair satisfied the constraints

keptColumns.description: which columns of the ORIGINAL alignment survived trimming - trimmed column 40 is not alignment column 40, and this is the map back

maxDegeneracyUsed.description: the degeneracy ceiling actually applied - LOWER than asked when no combination of IUPAC positions can multiply to the request

pairs.description: the primer pairs, best coverage first: both oligos in IUPAC letters, their degeneracy, the fraction of the family each binds, and the product span in trimmed columns

reverse.description: the best pair's reverse oligo AS ORDERED (reverse-complemented). Empty when no pair satisfied the constraints

windows.description: every scanned window with its degeneracy, entropy and coverage - the scan behind the pairs
